name: search_drugs_by_protein
description: Find drugs that target a specific protein based on its UniProt accession ID. Returns a list of drugs, their mechanisms of action, and relevant clinical information. Use this tool when you need to identify pharmacological agents related to a specific protein. Do NOT use this tool for general drug searches unrelated to proteins; for that, consider using 'search_drugs_by_name'.

parameters.name: accession_id
parameters.description: The UniProt accession identifier of the target protein, a 6 or 10 character alphanumeric code (e.g. 'P04637'). Case-insensitive but conventionally uppercase. Must be a valid UniProt accession; the function raises an error if not found.

parameters.name: include_clinical_data
parameters.description: Whether to include detailed clinical data about the drugs, such as indications and side effects. Set to false for a more concise response. Defaults to true.

drugs.description: List of drugs targeting the specified protein. Each item includes: drug_name (string), mechanism_of_action (string), and clinical_info (string, only present if include_clinical_data=true).

total_count.description: Total number of drugs found targeting the protein.

return_schema.description: Object containing 'drugs' (list of drug information) and 'total_count' (total matches).
